scenario: [LLOG.15.3]'s first bullet: an emit the literal break refutes compiles, unless it replaces a fact the rule itself matched. The HonestPolitician shape, with the flip made by a rule that binds no `Politician`. `hope` matches `Politician p where p.honest == true` and emits `Hope` `logical`; `corrupt` matches a `ttl` `Bribe` and the `Hope` it names, and emits that `Politician` with `honest: false`, which ends `hope`'s match and so the `Hope`'s justification. The edge `hope -> corrupt` stands (`Hope` emitted, matched). The edge `corrupt -> hope` drops: the emitted `honest: false` cannot satisfy `hope`'s `honest == true` ([LCYC.6.1], a `Bool` literal). `corrupt` matches no `Politician`, so it has no self-edge, and [LLOG.11.9]'s self-replacing arm does not apply: no pattern of `corrupt` binds the fact its emit replaces. The graph is acyclic and the program compiles. PATH PINNED: the Mercury compiler's literal break, `dsc.cycle.lcyc_6_1_dropped_edge`, applied to a cross-rule edge, and `dsc.validate.llog_11_9_self_replacing` finding no positive `Politician` pattern in `corrupt`. A cycle check without the cross-rule break keeps `corrupt -> hope`, puts both rules in one SCC with `Hope` emitted and matched inside it, and refuses with DS_VALIDATE_RULE_CYCLE ([LCYC.3.1.1]); an LLOG.11.9 arm that matched any emit of a schema some rule matches, rather than one the emitting rule binds, refuses with DS_VALIDATE_LOGICAL_EMIT_SELF_ENDING. Twins: LLOG.15.3_self_replacing_flip_refused, where `corrupt` binds the `Politician` it flips and LLOG.11.9 refuses it; and LLOG.15.3_withdraw_refused, where `corrupt` ends the match by `withdraw p`. Its run is LLOG.15.3_literal_flip_cascades_to_its_end.
rules_ds:
schema Politician scope logical:
    name: String key
    honest: Bool mutable

schema Hope scope logical:
    name: String key

schema Bribe scope ttl 1_h:
    target: String

rule hope:
    Politician p where p.honest == true
->
    emit Hope logical name: p.name

rule corrupt:
    Bribe b
    Hope h where h.name == b.target
->
    emit Politician logical name: b.target honest: false
